brief.goal: Add a minimal, exact workbench readonly-recovery path that creates a fresh Case-bound runtime Job after a stopped confirmed resource plan.

allowed_writes: Task, Context Manifest and project control-plane updates
workbench recovery runtime, documentation and test code
test_run and mock validation records only
forbidden_actions: all external platform writes and confirmation consumption
resource preparation execution, std_project/create, monitor creation or retry
OAuth refresh, budget or bid mutation
database schema or workflow_case_summary View changes
persisting sensitive or raw platform data
stop_conditions: a change requires a real platform write or plan confirmation
a recovery path duplicates Gate truth or permits arbitrary Job creation
a database migration or schema change becomes necessary
a public or persisted value could contain sensitive raw data
